comment: Milestone D, D1: the chr20 30x WGS the scale benchmark runs on. Every file is DERIVED from a public source by the command beside it, in the pinned image beside it, and is pinned by the sha256 of what that produces. Only chr20 is fetched, by range requests against each source's index. `python3 tools/speed/scale_data.py DIR` derives what is missing and checks every hash; `--pin` writes the hashes here.

reads.what: 1000 Genomes high coverage (NYGC), NA12878, 30x PCR-free 2x150, GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla

files.name: NA12878.chr20.cram
files.derive: samtools view -@ 4 -T chr20.fasta -C --output-fmt-option version=3.1 -o NA12878.chr20.cram NA12878.chr20.bam

files.name: read_names.txt
files.derive: samtools view NA12878.chr20.bam chr20:30000000-30100000 | cut -f1 | sort -u > read_names.txt

steps_comment: The best-practices chain on chr20. Each step reads the REFERENCE's output of the steps it needs (mounted at {in}/<step>), so both sides of every step get identical input, and a port failure upstream does not hide the steps below it. {threads} is the same on both sides: the JVM's pair-HMM and Spark threads, and the port's RAYON_NUM_THREADS. VCF writers hold --add-output-vcf-command-line false because ##GATKCommandLine carries the run's wall-clock time. `group` is the CI job a step runs in. `timeout` is seconds per side, chosen so a group's runs fit one 6-hour CI job; a side that reaches it is killed and recorded as such. Picard's MarkDuplicates runs beside MarkDuplicatesSpark on the same reads; the steps below read MarkDuplicatesSpark's output.

steps.name: VariantRecalibrator
steps.args: -R {data}/chr20.fasta -V {in}/GenotypeGVCFs/geno.vcf.gz -mode SNP --resource:hapmap,known=false,training=true,truth=true,prior=15.0 {data}/hapmap.chr20.vcf.gz --resource:omni,known=false,training=true,truth=false,prior=12.0 {data}/omni.chr20.vcf.gz --resource:1000G,known=false,training=true,truth=false,prior=10.0 {data}/phase1.chr20.vcf.gz --resource:dbsnp,known=true,training=false,truth=false,prior=2.0 {data}/dbsnp138.chr20.vcf.gz -an QD -an MQ -an MQRankSum -an ReadPosRankSum -an FS -an SOR --max-gaussians 6 -O {out}/snps.recal --tranches-file {out}/snps.tranches --add-output-vcf-command-line false

steps.name: ExtractVariantAnnotations
steps.args: -V {in}/GenotypeGVCFs/geno.vcf.gz -an QD -an MQ -an FS -an SOR -an MQRankSum -an ReadPosRankSum --resource:hapmap,training=true,calibration=true {data}/hapmap.chr20.vcf.gz --mode SNP -O {out}/extract

steps.name: ScoreVariantAnnotations
steps.args: -V {in}/GenotypeGVCFs/geno.vcf.gz -an QD -an MQ -an FS -an SOR -an MQRankSum -an ReadPosRankSum --resource:hapmap,training=true,calibration=true {data}/hapmap.chr20.vcf.gz --model-backend JAVA_BGMM --model-prefix {in}/TrainVariantAnnotationsModel/train --mode SNP -O {out}/score --add-output-vcf-command-line false

steps.name: CompareIntervalLists
steps.comment: One list against itself: two different lists end in a NoSuchElementException inside IntervalUtils.equateIntervals in GATK 4.7.0.0.

steps.name: GetPileupSummaries
steps.comment: Common sites (HapMap), as the tool is run: on all 5.6 million gnomAD sites GATK exhausts a 3.5 GiB heap.

steps.name: Pileup
steps.note: 10 Mb of chr20: the whole contig's pileup is ~6 GB of text per side

steps.name: LocalAssembler
steps.note: 1 Mb: the tool assembles one locus's reads, it is not meant for a whole contig

steps.name: CollectMultipleMetricsSpark
steps.comment: GATK exhausts the default 3.5 GiB heap on chr20 30x (OutOfMemoryError in a Spark task).

not_measured.GeneExpressionEvaluation: it counts RNA-seq reads per gene from a GFF3; the data is DNA and no annotation is pinned
not_measured.SplitNCigarReads: it splits RNA-seq reads at N cigar elements; WGS DNA reads carry none, so a run measures a copy, not the tool
not_measured.PostProcessReadsForRSEM: it prepares transcriptome-aligned RNA-seq reads for RSEM; the data is genome-aligned DNA
not_measured.MethylationTypeCaller: it calls methylation from bisulfite-converted reads; the data is not bisulfite
not_measured.AnalyzeSaturationMutagenesis: it reads deep amplicon reads of one ORF from a saturation-mutagenesis screen
not_measured.DownsampleByDuplicateSet: it groups duplex-consensus reads by molecular ID (MI tag); the data has no UMIs
not_measured.TransferReadTags: it copies UMI tags from an unaligned BAM of the same reads; the data has no unaligned UMI BAM
not_measured.FixMisencodedBaseQualityReads: it rewrites Phred+64 qualities; the data is Phred+33, and the reference refuses it
not_measured.ConvertHeaderlessHadoopBamShardToBam: its input is a headerless shard that only Hadoop-BAM's sharded writer makes
not_measured.CheckPileup: it compares the reads against a samtools pileup of the same data; a whole-chr20 pileup is ~6 GB of text that would have to be pinned
not_measured.MTLowHeteroplasmyFilterTool: a mitochondrial-pipeline filter; the data has no chrM
not_measured.NuMTFilterTool: a mitochondrial-pipeline filter; the data has no chrM
not_measured.MergeMutect2CallsWithMC3: it merges calls with the TCGA MC3 callset; MC3 is not public on GRCh38 chr20
not_measured.GetNormalArtifactData: it needs a tumour and a matched normal; NA12878 is one germline sample
not_measured.GatherNormalArtifactData: it gathers GetNormalArtifactData's shards, which need a tumour-normal pair
not_measured.CreateSomaticPanelOfNormals: it needs a GenomicsDB of several normals; there is one sample
not_measured.CreateReadCountPanelOfNormals: it needs read counts from a cohort of normals; there is one sample
not_measured.CalculateAverageCombinedAnnotations: it divides annotations a joint caller summed across samples; one sample has none summed
not_measured.RampedHaplotypeCaller: it replays HaplotypeCaller from on-ramp files a debugging run wrote; a realistic run of it is HaplotypeCaller's step
not_measured.FilterFuncotations: it filters Funcotator's output, which needs Funcotator's data sources (see Funcotator)
not_measured.Funcotator: its data sources (gnomAD, ClinVar, GENCODE, ...) are a ~20 GB tarball not sliced to chr20 and not pinned
not_measured.FuncotateSegments: its data sources are Funcotator's (see Funcotator)
not_measured.FuncotatorDataSourceDownloader: it downloads from the Broad's bucket: a network transfer, not a workload
not_measured.ParallelCopyGCSDirectoryIntoHDFSSpark: it copies between GCS and HDFS: neither exists in the runner
not_measured.HtsgetReader: it streams from an htsget server: a network client, timed against a local server by its own suite
not_measured.PathSeqBuildReferenceTaxonomy: it needs NCBI's RefSeq/GenBank catalogs and taxdump; none is pinned
not_measured.PathSeqBwaSpark: it aligns to a microbial BWA image; no microbial reference is pinned
not_measured.PathSeqScoreSpark: it scores alignments to a microbial reference and taxonomy; neither is pinned
not_measured.PathSeqPipelineSpark: it needs PathSeqBwaSpark's and PathSeqScoreSpark's microbial references
not_measured.NVScoreVariants: its reference needs GATK's conda environment (gatkpythonpackages, gcnvkernel, PyTorch or scikit-learn), which the pinned timing image does not carry; it is measured on fixtures by Speed (#1494) and needs the broadinstitute/gatk image to time at scale

java_options_comment: The reference's heap on every CPU: what a 14 GiB container gives a JVM by default (a quarter), set explicitly so a smaller local container times the same JVM.
cram_comment: The CRAM keeps the 30x run's whole GRCh38 header, so a chr20-only reference is a subset of its dictionary: GATK refuses that for CRAM unless the dictionary check is off, which the CRAM steps turn off on both sides.
